content.text:
You are the Niyam encoder. Update this rulebook so it matches a new government document.

The validated change set is in `.niyam/changeset.json`. It lists each change with its exact source quote, page and clause.
The source document is registered in `sources/index.yaml` as `gr-202307061137387522` (date 2023-07-05).

Do this:
1. Read CLAUDE.md (the rulebook rules), the change set, and the files of the affected scheme(s): mh.sanjay_gandhi_niradhar.
2. Apply every change in the change set, following CLAUDE.md exactly:
   - parameter change: add a new dated value under `values:` starting 2023-07-05. Never edit or delete older values.
   - condition change: set `valid_until` on the old condition to the day before 2023-07-05, and add a new condition with the same id and `valid_from: 2023-07-05`.
   - condition removed: only set `valid_until` to the day before 2023-07-05.
   - every new value or condition gets `source` / `metadata.reference` with doc `gr-202307061137387522`, page, clause, quote (copied from the change set) and quote_en.
   - if a change needs a new person field, add it to `schema/person.yaml` with a safe default that keeps existing results unchanged.
3. Add test citizens to `tests/` for every change, dated on or after 2023-07-05: just below, at, and just above each limit, plus one case dated before 2023-07-05 proving the old rule still applies. Each case cites `GR 202307061137387522 p.<page> clause <clause>` in `source`.
4. Add an entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md (English, Hindi, Marathi) linking to the document.
5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and fix problems until it prints `0 failed` with no PROBLEM lines.
6. Do not run git. Do not edit files outside schemes/, parameters/, tests/, sources/, glossary/, schema/ and CHANGELOG.md.

Finish with a short summary of what you changed and the final test result.
I'll start by reading the change set, the scheme files, and the existing rulebook layout.

2	
3	Plain-language record of every rule change. Newest first. Each entry is in
4	English, Hindi and Marathi and links to its source.

6	## 1 September 2019: Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (GR dated 20 August 2019)
7	
8	- English: The scheme starts on 1 September 2019 with revised rules. People who have lived in Maharashtra for at least 15 years, are aged 18 to 64, have a family income up to Rs 21,000 a year (Rs 50,000 for disabled people), and get no regular benefit from another government scheme, get Rs 1,000 a month. Widows with one child get Rs 1,100 and widows with two or more children get Rs 1,200.
9	- हिंदी: संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजना 1 सितंबर 2019 से संशोधित नियमों के साथ शुरू होती है। जो व्यक्ति महाराष्ट्र में कम से कम 15 वर्ष से रह रहे हैं, 18 से 64 वर्ष की आयु के हैं, जिनके परिवार की वार्षिक आय 21,000 रुपये तक है (दिव्यांगों के लिए 50,000 रुपये), और किसी अन्य सरकारी योजना से नियमित मासिक लाभ नहीं लेते, उन्हें हर महीने 1,000 रुपये मिलेंगे। एक अपत्य वाली विधवाओं को 1,100 रुपये और दो या अधिक अपत्य वाली विधवाओं को 1,200 रुपये मिलेंगे।
10	- मराठी: संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजना १ सप्टेंबर २०१९ पासून सुधारित नियमांसह सुरू होत आहे. महाराष्ट्रात किमान १५ वर्षांपासून रहिवासी, १८ ते ६४ वयोगटातील, ज्यांचे कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न २१,००० रुपयांपर्यंत आहे (दिव्यांगांसाठी ५०,००० रुपये) आणि इतर कोणत्याही शासकीय योजनेतून नियमित मासिक लाभ घेत नाहीत, त्यांना दरमहा १,००० रुपये मिळतील. एक अपत्य असलेल्या विधवांना १,१०० रुपये आणि दोन किंवा अधिक अपत्ये असलेल्या विधवांना १,२०० रुपये मिळतील.
11	- Source: [GR 201908211212469922](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/201908211212469922.pdf)
12	
13	## Baseline: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana (GR dated 28 June 2024)
14	
15	- English: The scheme starts. Women aged 21 to 60 in Maharashtra, from families earning up to Rs 2.5 lakh a year, can get Rs 1,500 a month.
16	- हिंदी: योजना शुरू हुई। महाराष्ट्र की 21 से 60 वर्ष की महिलाएं, जिनके परिवार की वार्षिक आय 2.5 लाख रुपये तक है, हर महीने 1,500 रुपये पा सकती हैं।
17	- मराठी: योजना सुरू झाली. महाराष्ट्रातील 21 ते 60 वयोगटातील महिला, ज्यांच्या कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न 2.5 लाख रुपयांपर्यंत आहे, त्यांना दरमहा 1,500 रुपये मिळू शकतात.
18	- Source: [GR 202406281814018230](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/202406281814018230.pdf)

1	# Instructions for coding agents working in this rulebook
2	
3	This repository is the Niyam rulebook: Maharashtra welfare scheme eligibility
4	rules as tested code. Every rule must trace back to an official government
5	document. Wrong rules can stop people from receiving money they are owed.
6	
7	## Layout
8	- `schemes/<state>/<scheme>.yaml`: conditions and benefit. Every condition has `valid_from`, optional `valid_until`, and a `source` (doc, page, clause, quote, quote_en).
9	- `parameters/<state>/<scheme>/<name>.yaml`: dated values in OpenFisca format. Each value has `metadata.reference` (doc, page, clause, quote, quote_en).
10	- `tests/<state>/<scheme>.yaml`: test citizens. Each case has `date`, `person`, `expect` and `source`.
11	- `sources/index.yaml` and `sources/<state>/<code>.pdf`: the official documents.
12	- `glossary/maharashtra.md`: how recurring legal phrases are interpreted.
13	- `schema/person.yaml`: the only facts rules may use. Never add personal identifiers.
14	
15	## Rules for every change
16	1. Never edit or delete history. To change a parameter, add a new dated value. To change a condition, set `valid_until` on the old one (the day before the change) and add a new condition with the same `id` and a new `valid_from`. To remove a condition, only set `valid_until`.
17	2. Every new value and condition must have a source with the exact quote from the document, its page and clause.
18	3. Add the source document to `sources/index.yaml` (and the PDF to `sources/<state>/`).
19	4. For every change add at least three test cases dated after the change: just below, at, and just above each limit, plus one case dated before the change showing the old rule still applies.
20	5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and do not stop until it prints `0 failed` and no PROBLEM lines.
21	6. Add a plain-language entry at the top of `CHANGELOG.md` in English, Hindi and Marathi.
22	7. Only edit files inside `schemes/`, `parameters/`, `tests/`, `sources/`, `glossary/`, `schema/` and `CHANGELOG.md`.
23	8. Rule expressions may only use `person.<field>`, `params.<name>`, comparisons, `and`, `or`, `not`, arithmetic, lists, and `min`, `max`, `abs`, `len`.
24

## 5 July 2023: Higher assistance under Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana (GR dated 5 July 2023)

- English: From 5 July 2023 the monthly assistance for every beneficiary of the Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana rises from Rs 1,000 to Rs 1,500. Widows with one child, who got Rs 1,100, and widows with two or more children, who got Rs 1,200, now also get Rs 1,500. Who is eligible does not change.
- हिंदी: 5 जुलाई 2023 से संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजना के सभी लाभार्थियों को हर महीने मिलने वाली सहायता 1,000 रुपये से बढ़कर 1,500 रुपये हो जाती है। एक अपत्य वाली विधवाओं को, जिन्हें 1,100 रुपये मिलते थे, और दो या अधिक अपत्य वाली विधवाओं को, जिन्हें 1,200 रुपये मिलते थे, अब भी 1,500 रुपये मिलेंगे। पात्रता के नियम नहीं बदले हैं।
- मराठी: ५ जुलै २०२३ पासून संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजनेतील सर्व लाभार्थ्यांना दरमहा मिळणारे अर्थसहाय्य १,००० रुपयांवरून १,५०० रुपये होते. एक अपत्य असलेल्या विधवांना, ज्यांना १,१०० रुपये मिळत होते, आणि दोन किंवा अधिक अपत्ये असलेल्या विधवांना, ज्यांना १,२०० रुपये मिळत होते, त्यांनाही आता १,५०० रुपये मिळतील. पात्रतेचे नियम बदललेले नाहीत.
- Source: [GR 202307061137387522](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/202307061137387522.pdf)
